scope: Systematically selected newly emitted estimates on the same five-minute NBHL recording. Conditional assistant visual audit, not independent invisible-ball ground truth. Approximate visible locations were inspected after predictions were frozen.
reviewer: assistant visual inspection of native chronological panels
